analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 37.1 entering oversold territory, attempting rebound after 5 consecutive down days. ADX at 27.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is stronger than +DI. MACD histogram shows improvement, but volume at 0.68 of 5-day average suggests weak buying pressure. Positioned at 23.7% of 52-week range, indicating potential for further downside. Given the 3x leverage nature of the product, volatility is a concern, thus a wait-and-see approach is warranted.
